root.label: Jackson Chourio reaches three 20-homer seasons before age 23

events.label: Jackson Chourio reaches three 20-homer seasons before age 23

slots.name: season home runs
slots.sentence: Chourio hit his 20th homer of the season in a 5-3 victory over the Texas Rangers on Saturday night.

slots.name: milestone ranking
slots.sentence: He’s the 17th player to put together three 20-homer seasons before turning 23 years old, joining a star-studded fraternity that includes Hall of Famers Ted Williams, Eddie Mathews, Mickey Mantle, Frank Robinson and Orlando Cepeda among others.

slots.name: contract value
slots.sentence: The Brewers understood what they had in Chourio back in 2023 as they signed him to an eight-year, $82 million contract when he was a 19-year-old who hadn’t yet reached the big leagues.

slots.name: stolen bases
slots.sentence: The injury may keep him from a third straight 20-20 season — he currently has 14 steals — but Chourio is on pace for career highs in batting average (.281), on-base percentage (.342) and slugging percentage (.478).

slots.name: win streak
slots.sentence: “He’s still learning the game,” Brewers manager Pat Murphy said. “Man, he’s special. His hands go from A to B as quick as anybody.”

slots.name: postseason games
slots.sentence: Milwaukee won its fourth straight game Saturday and has the best record in the major leagues as the Brewers chase the first World Series title in franchise history.

slots.name: first game date
slots.sentence: Although Chourio continued playing in the WBC and helped Venezuela win the title, he went on the injured list as the Brewers opened the season and didn’t play his first game until May 4.

slots.name: career postseason games
slots.sentence: Chourio already has shown a knack for thriving in October thus far in his brief career, as he has hit .341 with four homers and 11 RBIs in 12 career postseason games.
